method.name: EYA for Oracle Services
method.description: A unique end-to-end hybrid agile approach for implementing Oracle services at a client organization that is based on the EY Accelerate (EYA) methodology. The detailed work breakdown structure in this method showcases a traditional, sequentially phased waterfall approach that incorporates a set of business process-driven, agile-like progressive build cycles, which accelerate delivery and provide incremental value to the client.
